locked: The vault is locked. The connections are there, their credentials are not — and as long as that is the case, nothing can be changed here.
secretsMissing: The project key is missing for at least one connection. That means: shared, but nobody with access has been online since to wrap it. It resolves itself as soon as someone from the project opens the app.
pending: {n} change not uploaded yet. It goes along with the next sync — everything here is already up to date. | {n} changes not uploaded yet. They go along with the next sync — everything here is already up to date.
adminOnly: Only an administrator may create and delete projects in this workspace.
